answer: A stake-bonded registry resists Sybils by forcing every identity to lock a refundable bond that is slashed on misbehaviour. At its nadir, a fake account is worthless: creating it costs real capital, not a free signup. Honest agents climb toward the zenith of reputation as bonds age and work is attested, so the fable of effortless free identities collapses. An attacker must fund every sock puppet, and each slashed bond is money gone, while the honest cost stays flat.
